identity.name: Looksy
identity.core_philosophy: Fashion Magazine x Social Network. Minimalist White Global Theme with Radical Contextual Inversions.

primary_font.name: Playfair Display
primary_font.note: Chosen as the high-quality Google Font alternative to 'Orange Avenue' for stability.

secondary_font.name: Manrope
secondary_font.usage: Body text, UI elements, Buttons, Inputs

layout_strategies.global_spacing: Generous. Use p-6 or p-8 for containers. Avoid cramped UI.

navigation.style: Tab-based top or bottom navigation depending on device.
navigation.behavior: Clicking a tab MUST change the entire page theme (bg color) instantly.

feed.style: Editorial Feed. Not just a list of cards.
feed.metadata_display: Minimalist. Overlay price tags on hover or click.

stars_grid.rule: Only display photos with >10k likes here.
stars_grid.highlight: Gold border or glow for these elite items.

buttons.style: Sharp edges or Pill shape. No default rounded-md.

cards.style: Cardless. Use whitespace to separate items. If borders are needed, use 1px opacity-10.

inputs.style: Underlined only (border-b) or minimal bg-gray-50. No heavy borders.

monetization.display: Private 'Total Earnings' box on user profile. Use a blurred glass effect container.

upload_flow.ui: Clean, step-by-step wizard or single elegant form.

instructions_to_main_agent: 2. THEME: Implement a 'ThemeContext' that wraps the app. It must hold the current category state (Global, Men, Women, Stars).
3. ROUTING: /men -> Black Theme. /women -> Red Theme. /stars -> White Theme + Grid. / -> White Theme.
4. FONTS: Add the Google Fonts links to the index.html or main CSS file. Use 'Playfair Display' for all headings.
5. AUTH: Mock Google Auth if real creds are missing, but UI must show 'Continue with Google'.
6. DATA: Create a mock data store for Users, Photos (with likes count), and Comments to demonstrate the logic.
7. TESTING: Add data-testid to all interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs).
universal_guidelines: Do not use gradients for the main background. Use solid colors (White, Black, Dark Red).
Ensure text contrast is AA compliant. White text on Red bg might need opacity adjustments.
Do not center text in the feed. Left align captions.
